payload.text: I need to optimize this website. Keep the same colors. But provide suggestions and optimizations for it.

**Defining the Conversion Goal**

I'm currently focused on the initial phase. I've broken down the central request to convert a single-page HTML/JS site (Vitannis) into a modern React application. Key requirements include using TypeScript and Tailwind CSS while maintaining the original site's visuals.


**Analyzing the Current Design**

I'm now diving into the specifics. I'm taking the time to map out the colors, fonts (Montserrat, Cormorant Garamond), and the structure of the existing site, especially the header and the individual sections. I will have a very clear picture of the initial conversion when I'm done. I'm focusing on the user's color palette, and trying to reproduce it faithfully.


**Mapping Out Content Sections**

I've just finished outlining the content sections and components for the React application. I've broken down each page's key elements: Hero sections, service cards, trusted carriers, and partner sections. I've also identified the specific sections such as business, individuals, and about. I'm focusing on defining the individual components now, to make the structure easier to follow.


**Integrating AI Functionality**

I'm now focusing on integrating the AI functionality using the Gemini API. I plan to use the `@google/genai` library, with `gemini-3-flash-preview` as the model, per the system prompt recommendations for text generation tasks, as the user is requesting optimizations. I'll be using `process.env.API_KEY` for API key handling and will retain the original system prompts from the user's HTML. I'm focusing on the `gemini.ts` file. I'm prioritizing services such as `Individuals`, `Partners`, `About`, `Contact`, and `Tools` sections.


**Structuring the Code**

I've outlined a step-by-step implementation plan. I'm focusing on setting up the project with `metadata.json`, `index.html`, and `index.tsx`. I'll create `tailwind.config` and `types.ts` next. After that, I will move on to the services and then to the UI components. Finally, I will address the page components, and the main App structure.


**Defining the Style Guide**

I'm now nailing down the styling details. I'm focusing on defining the custom color palette within `tailwind.config`, ensuring an exact match with the original design using the provided color codes. I'll be importing the necessary Google Fonts within `index.html`. Furthermore, I intend to implement the icons via `lucide-react`, ensuring visual consistency.

**Implementing the "Tools" Page**

I'm now focusing on the "Tools" page implementation. I'll need to manage state for `input`, `loading`, `result`, and `error`. I'm going to carefully handle the AI response; I'll use either simple whitespace pre-wrap formatting, basic HTML injection, or a newline-to-break utility to ensure it's rendered properly.


**Refining the Text Display**

I've decided on the text formatting for AI responses, prioritizing robustness. I'll stick with the `whitespace: pre-wrap` CSS property for now, ensuring a reliable display. I'm moving toward implementing `generateInsight` within `aiService.ts`. I'm starting with the initial HTML page structure and necessary imports in the `index.html` file. I'll be defining a `Page` enum in `types.ts`.


**Defining Code Consistency**

I'm now focusing on ensuring all the code fits together. I'm double-checking the model use, and I will be using `gemini-3-flash-preview` to enhance the "Strategic Assessment" tool. I'm also reviewing against key constraints such as using a single XML file, React 18, and Tailwind. Finally, I'm verifying the system instructions, ensuring the "Policy Decoder" and "Strategic Assessment" have distinct instructions.
